candidates.full_answer:
### 1. Clinical Guidance
For patients who are already taking some medications for other illnesses, they should be advised to continue those medications after a thorough examination by an ayurveda physician [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0009-9567185C5928 | DM RR.md |  | 3]. 

Additionally, when these well-diagnosed patients visit an ayurvedic clinic and ayurvedic diagnosis begins with Hetu, Lakshane, Samprapti, and sometimes already prevalent complications of DM, one of the most important factors a Vaidya has to consider is the modern medicines the patient is consuming, as all these medicines are likely to be uptarpanottha in nature and equally interfere with Samprapti [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0004-C041A5942B91 | DM RR.md |  | 2].

### 2. Evidence from Retrieved Guidelines
- "Patients who are already taking some medications for other illnesses should be advised to continue those medications after thorough examination by an ayurveda physician." [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0009-9567185C5928 | DM RR.md |  | 3]
- "One has to understand in clinical settings that these well diagnosed patients by modern medicine when visit ayurvedic clinic and ayurvedic diagnosis starts with Hetu, Lakshane, Samprapti, sometimes already prevalent complications of DM. One of the most important factors a Vaidya has to consider is modern medicines the patient is consuming. All these medicines are likely to be uptarpanottha in nature which equally interferes with Samprapti." [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0004-C041A5942B91 | DM RR.md |  | 2]

### 3. Limitations & Missing Information
- Specific dosages, vehicles (Sahpaan), timing (Aushadh Kal), frequencies, and durations for continuing other medications are not specified in the provided guideline.

### 1. Clinical Guidance
For a patient in the **Moderate** state (pneumonia, adolescent or adult with presence of clinical features of dyspnea and/or hypoxia, fever, cough, SpO2 <94% in the range of 90–94% on room air, and respiratory rate $\ge$ 24 per minute), the guideline specifies the following criteria and investigations [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | Page 24]:

* **Criteria:** Pneumonia, adolescent or adult with presence of clinical features of Dyspnea and or Hypoxia, Fever, Cough, SpO2<94% (range 90-94%) on room air, Respiratory rate more or equal to 24 per min [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | Page 24].
* **Investigations:** 
  * CBC, RFT, LFT, RBS, ECG, ABG, ESR, CRP, S. FERRITIN, D- DIMER/LDH [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | Page 24].
  * If QTc prolongation in ECG then daily S. Electrolytes ionic Calcium and Magnesium [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | Page 24].
  * HRCT chest [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | Page 24].
  * Follow up CRP, D- dimer and Sr. Ferritin every 48-72 hrs. If available [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | Page 24].
  * CBC with DLC, absolute lymphocyte count KFT/LFT daily [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | Page 24].

Clinical Guidance For a patient in the **MODERATE** state (defined as pneumonia, adolescent or adult with clinical features of dyspnea and/or hypoxia, fever, cough, $\text{SpO}_2 < 94\%$ in the range of 90–94% on room air, and respiratory rate $\ge 24$ per minute), the investigation protocol specifies the following criteria and investigations [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | 24]: * **Criteria:** Pneumonia, adolescent or adult with presence of clinical features of dyspnea and/or hypoxia, fever, cough, $\text{SpO}_2 < 94\%$ (range 90–94%) on room air, respiratory rate more or equal to 24 per min [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | 24]. * **Investigations:** CBC, RFT, LFT, RBS, ECG, ABG, ESR, CRP, S. FERRITIN, D-DIMER/LDH [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | 24]. * *Additional/Conditional Investigations:* * If QTc prolongation in ECG: daily S. Electrolytes (ionic Calcium and Magnesium) [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | 24]. * HRCT chest [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | 24]. * Follow-up CRP, D-dimer, and Sr. Ferritin every 48–72 hours (if available) [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | 24]. * CBC with DLC, absolute lymphocyte count, KFT/LFT daily [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | 24]. --- ### 2. Evidence from Retrieved Guidelines | State | Criteria | Investigations | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **MODERATE** | Pneumonia, Adolescent or adult with presence of clinical features of Dyspnea and or Hypoxia, Fever, Cough, $\text{SpO}_2 < 94\%$ (range 90-94%) on room air, Respiratory rate more or equal to 24 per min. | CBC, RFT, LFT, RBS, ECG, ABG, ESR, CRP, S. FERRITIN, D- DIMER/LDH

* If QTc prolongation in ECG then daily S. Electrolytes ionic Calcium and Magnesium.
* HRCT chest
* Follow up CRP, D- dimer and Sr. Ferritin every 48-72 hrs. If available
* CBC with DLC, absolute lymphocyte count KFT/LFT daily | [DOC-FC76496810AB-0055-97B327D64EF1 | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | INVESTIGATION PROTOCOL | 24] --- ### 3. case_results.full_answer:
### 1. Clinical Guidance
For people with no significant comorbidities during seasonal or epidemic viral infections, the following Rasayana options are recommended for prophylactic use (Nitya Rasayan Sevan):

- **Pranvir**
  - **Matra:** 2-0-2 [DOC-FC76496810AB-0022-E78671F0BE7D | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | PROPHYLACTIC GUIDELINES | 10]
  - **Sahpaan:** Warm water [DOC-FC76496810AB-0022-E78671F0BE7D | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | PROPHYLACTIC GUIDELINES | 10]
  - **Aushadh Kal:** Vyanodaan kal (twice a day after food) [DOC-FC76496810AB-0022-E78671F0BE7D | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | PROPHYLACTIC GUIDELINES | 10]

- **Rasaka Rasayana**
  - **Matra:** 1-0-0 [DOC-FC76496810AB-0022-E78671F0BE7D | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | PROPHYLACTIC GUIDELINES | 10]
  - **Sahpaan:** Honey/warm water [DOC-FC76496810AB-0022-E78671F0BE7D | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | PROPHYLACTIC GUIDELINES | 10]
  - **Aushadh Kal:** Rasayan kal (Early morning on empty stomach) [DOC-FC76496810AB-0022-E78671F0BE7D | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | PROPHYLACTIC GUIDELINES | 10]

---

### 2. Evidence from Retrieved Guidelines
- **Context:** Nitya Rasayan Sevan as prophylaxis for seasonal or epidemic viral infections in people with no significant comorbidities [DOC-FC76496810AB-0022-E78671F0BE7D | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | PROPHYLACTIC GUIDELINES | 10].
- **General Instruction:** These Rasayanas are noted to be safe for long-term consumption and can be administered for Nitya Sevan on a regular basis till the risk of infection is reduced significantly [DOC-FC76496810AB-0021-2F5EB5E3171A | Respiratory Viral Infection Management prorocol_FINAL version-converted-1-25 (1).md | PROPHYLACTIC GUIDELINES | 10].

---

### 3. Limitations & Missing Information
Not specified in the provided guideline regarding any exact duration of treatment beyond the instruction to take them on a regular basis until the risk of infection is reduced significantly.

case_results.query: What Ayurvedic medicines such as Sunetra Rasayan or Niketa Rasayan are recommended for treating eye complications and blurred vision in patients with diabetes (diabetic retinopathy)?

matched_elements: Early-stage diabetic retinopathy/blurred vision: Sunetra Rasayan 1-0-1 with honey + cow ghee, Vyanodaan kal twice a day after food; Rasaka Rasayana 1-0-1 with honey/warm water, Rasayan kal and Nisha kal.

Late-stage dark spots/active bleeding: Niketa Rasayan 1-0-1 with honey/warm water, Vyanodaan kal twice a day after food; Netraj Rasayan 1-0-1 with honey/warm water, Vyanodaan kal twice a day after food.
If diabetes: add Zincare 2-0-2 with warm water, Vyanodaan kal; if nephropathy: add Urokine 2-0-2; if IHD: add Arpisa Rasayana 1-0-0; if hypertension: add Sutendra Rasayana 1-0-0.

  - **Sunetra Rasayan:** Matra: 1-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey+cow ghee | Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal (twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0057-CEEF567088AF | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | Page 20]

  - **Niketa Rasayan:** Matra: 1-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal (twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0057-CEEF567088AF | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | Page 20]

### 1. Clinical Guidance

For the management of diabetic retinopathy (Pramehaj Netragat Vyaadhi) and related symptoms such as blurred vision in patients with diabetes, the retrieved guidelines recommend the following treatments based on the stage and clinical presentation:

*   **For Early Stage (Blurred vision, Floaters in vision, Risk of vitreous/retinal haemorrhage, macular thickness ++):**
    *   **Sunetra Rasayan**: Matra: 1-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey+cow ghee | Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal (twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0057-CEEF567088AF | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]
    *   **Rasaka Rasayana**: Matra: 1-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Rasayan kal and Nisha kal (Early morning on empty stomach and at bedtime) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0057-CEEF567088AF | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]

*   **For Late Stage (Dark spots in vision/Active bleeding-vitreous-retinal/maculopathy):**
    *   **Niketa Rasayan**: Matra: 1-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal (twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0057-CEEF567088AF | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]
    *   **Netraj Rasayan**: Matra: 1-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal (twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0058-A06FED5CCE53 | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]

*   **For General Vyadhi Pratyanik - Nitya Sevanarth (Diabetic Retinopathy):**
    *   **Heerak Rasayan**: Matra: 1-0-0 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Rasayan Kal (Early morning on empty stomach) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0057-CEEF567088AF | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]
    *   **Meha Rasayan**: Matra: 0-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Nisha kal (At bedtime) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0057-CEEF567088AF | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]

*   **For Aavil Drushti (Blurred Vision) under General Prameh Management:**
    *   **Zincare**: Matra: 2-0-2 | Sahpaan: Warm water | Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal (twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0022-5B279F963A19 | DM RR.md | PRAMEH (DIABETES MELLITUS) MANAGEMENT | p. 10]
    *   **Meha Rasayan**: Matra: 0-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Nisha Kal (At bedtime) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0022-5B279F963A19 | DM RR.md | PRAMEH (DIABETES MELLITUS) MANAGEMENT | p. 10]
    *   **Niketa**: Matra: 1-0-0 or 1-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal (once or twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0022-5B279F963A19 | DM RR.md | PRAMEH (DIABETES MELLITUS) MANAGEMENT | p. 10]

*   **For Comorbidities associated with Pramehaj Netragat Vyaadhi:**
    *   If patient has Diabetes only: Add **Zincare** (Matra: 2-0-2, Sahpaan: Warm water, Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0058-A06FED5CCE53 | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]
    *   If patient has nephropathy (Mutraghaat): Add **Urokine** (Matra: 2-0-2, Sahpaan: Warm water, Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0058-A06FED5CCE53 | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]
    *   If patient has IHD (Hrudrog): Add **Arpisa Rasayana** (Matra: 1-0-0, Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water, Aushadh Kal: Rasayan Kal early morning on empty stomach) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0058-A06FED5CCE53 | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]
    *   If patient has Hypertension (Rasaabhinodan vruddhi): Add **Sutendra Rasayana** (Matra: 1-0-0, Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water, Aushadh Kal: Rasayan Kal early morning on empty stomach) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0058-A06FED5CCE53 | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]

### 1. Clinical Guidance

For the management of diabetic retinopathy (Pramehaj Netragat Vyaadhi) and related symptoms such as blurred vision in patients with diabetes, the retrieved guidelines recommend the following treatments based on the stage and clinical presentation:

*   **For Early Stage (Blurred vision, Floaters in vision, Risk of vitreous/retinal haemorrhage, macular thickness ++):**
    *   **Sunetra Rasayan**: Matra: 1-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey+cow ghee | Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal (twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0057-CEEF567088AF | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]
    *   **Rasaka Rasayana**: Matra: 1-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Rasayan kal and Nisha kal (Early morning on empty stomach and at bedtime) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0057-CEEF567088AF | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]

*   **For Late Stage (Dark spots in vision/Active bleeding-vitreous-retinal/maculopathy):**
    *   **Niketa Rasayan**: Matra: 1-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal (twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0057-CEEF567088AF | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]
    *   **Netraj Rasayan**: Matra: 1-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal (twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0058-A06FED5CCE53 | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]

*   **For General Vyadhi Pratyanik - Nitya Sevanarth (Diabetic Retinopathy):**
    *   **Heerak Rasayan**: Matra: 1-0-0 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Rasayan Kal (Early morning on empty stomach) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0057-CEEF567088AF | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]
    *   **Meha Rasayan**: Matra: 0-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Nisha kal (At bedtime) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0057-CEEF567088AF | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]

*   **For Aavil Drushti (Blurred Vision) under General Prameh Management:**
    *   **Zincare**: Matra: 2-0-2 | Sahpaan: Warm water | Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal (twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0022-5B279F963A19 | DM RR.md | PRAMEH (DIABETES MELLITUS) MANAGEMENT | p. 10]
    *   **Meha Rasayan**: Matra: 0-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Nisha Kal (At bedtime) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0022-5B279F963A19 | DM RR.md | PRAMEH (DIABETES MELLITUS) MANAGEMENT | p. 10]
    *   **Niketa**: Matra: 1-0-0 or 1-0-1 | Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water | Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal (once or twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0022-5B279F963A19 | DM RR.md | PRAMEH (DIABETES MELLITUS) MANAGEMENT | p. 10]

*   **For Comorbidities associated with Pramehaj Netragat Vyaadhi:**
    *   If patient has Diabetes only: Add **Zincare** (Matra: 2-0-2, Sahpaan: Warm water, Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0058-A06FED5CCE53 | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]
    *   If patient has nephropathy (Mutraghaat): Add **Urokine** (Matra: 2-0-2, Sahpaan: Warm water, Aushadh Kal: Vyanodaan kal twice a day after food) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0058-A06FED5CCE53 | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]
    *   If patient has IHD (Hrudrog): Add **Arpisa Rasayana** (Matra: 1-0-0, Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water, Aushadh Kal: Rasayan Kal early morning on empty stomach) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0058-A06FED5CCE53 | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]
    *   If patient has Hypertension (Rasaabhinodan vruddhi): Add **Sutendra Rasayana** (Matra: 1-0-0, Sahpaan: Honey/ warm water, Aushadh Kal: Rasayan Kal early morning on empty stomach) [DOC-5FFD839CD910-0058-A06FED5CCE53 | DM RR.md | 3.PRAMEHAJ NETRAGAT VYAADHI (DIABETIC RETINOPATHY) | p. 20]
